text: Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez here. I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Looking at my calendar, the half-hours I have free are Monday 10:00–10:30, Tuesday 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wednesday 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30. What suits you, and how long should we plan for?

Hi Professor — glad to hear from you. I checked my calendar against your free half-hours:

- Monday 10:00–10:30 — I'm booked (Focus: CSE452 lab runs 09:50–11:00)
- Tuesday 11:00–11:30 — I'm booked from 11:10 (Lunch 11:10–12:10)
- Tuesday 15:00–15:30 — free
- Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — free
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — free

My preference would be Wednesday 10:00–10:30: it sits right before my CSE455 office hours (10:30–12:00), so if we need to follow up with students afterwards we're already in place. Tuesday 15:00–15:30 or Wednesday 13:00–13:30 work equally well if those suit you better.

Since all three windows are half an hour, shall we plan for 30 minutes? If you'd like longer, tell me how long and I'll look for a bigger gap on my side. Confirm the slot and I'll book it.
Wednesday 10:00–10:30 it is, 30 minutes — that works well for me too. I've put it in my calendar. See you then, and thanks for checking your side so carefully.
Booked: Wednesday 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting. It's in my calendar and logged. See you then — I'll bring the office-hours list in case anything needs a quick decision.
Perfect — the list will help. See you Wednesday.
